issue_request: FHIR-15614 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core change request asking spreadsheet authoring to capture both descriptive and computable names for profiles and extensions, and to expose both names during publication.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn 14848, but git-svn history shows the substantive adjacent application as 434b134490aac49a8d7ed62856b41317e6ef6a77, build@14849, titled 'GF#15614 - fix name/title parsing in IG spreadsheets'. That commit updated the historical IgSpreadsheetParser to read Profile.name and Profile.title columns for profile and extension StructureDefinitions; build@14848 itself was only a build-file fix, and dce1c6d144781e8e53b187d6e598cf8917467949 began related name/title parsing work earlier that day.
additional_context: The historical tools/java/org.hl7.fhir.igtools IgSpreadsheetParser.java file was removed from this checkout when the IG publisher moved to Maven and during later Java cleanup. The current build uses the external org.hl7.fhir:kindling dependency and runs org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher from that dependency. Current active core extension source has separate Name and Title columns, and the extension template exposes Computable Name.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The source file that implemented the Jira request is now outside this FHIR source checkout, and no safe in-scope core source hunk is required to replay the historical parser fix.
